notes: *it* after *he did* answers to no object morpheme and is added (rule 44).
In *the service of the house of God* the single article morpheme takes the *the* before *house*, the outer construct taking a supplied one (rule 29), matching 31:13.
The לְ of לֵאלֹהָיו is unrepresented, the ASV writing a bare object *seek his God* (rule 40).
